decisions: No new generic validators or unrelated features before Pattern #1 and Pattern #2 are executable.
Default user-visible preset may never be knowingly rejected.
Until parameter variants are individually proven, Pattern #1 exposes only fixed 3/7/11 and Pattern #2 exposes only the fixed four-round construction.
Do not weaken layout/crochet validation to manufacture PASS.
Do not claim 100% execution without production plus physical/user execution evidence.
next_actions: Production-browser test fixed 5-Petal 3/7/11: require generation PASS, zero clipping/genuine collisions, recognizable chart and visible written instructions.
Production-browser test SC Coaster: require visible ch-1 starts, exact 6→12→18→24 sc construction, one closure per round, zero clipping/collisions and visible written instructions.
If production differs from main, diagnose deployment/cache before changing crochet logic.
If either runtime rejects, fix the exact runtime/layout defect only.
Keep both families BETA until execution evidence is stronger; physical crochet samples remain the strongest proof against hidden ambiguity.
